mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer
AND customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{customerName}, '%')
AND phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{phone}, '%')
AND status = #{status}
SELECT FROM customer WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY customer_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer (customer_id, customer_name, contact_person, phone, address, status) VALUES (#{customerId}, #{customerName}, #{contactPerson}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE customer SET customer_name = #{customerName}, contact_person = #{contactPerson}, phone = #{phone}, address = #{address}, status = #{status} WHERE customer_id = #{customerId}
